topic: Sanji was the crew's quiet protector across the Egghead arc
title: Sanji Was The Crew's Quiet Hero At Egghead
description: While Zoro and Luffy got the loud fights, Sanji spent Egghead keeping people on their feet. Here is the pattern from chapter 1066 onward. Do you agree he had the arc's best role?
comment: Did Sanji have the best role at Egghead, or did Zoro and Luffy own the arc? Pick one.

lines.text: Sanji had the quietest Egghead on the whole crew, and the most important.

shot.fallback: blond cook in an orange floral shirt

lines.text: It starts in chapter 1066, when Shaka lays out the Void Century secrets.

shot.fallback: scientist explaining secrets to a shocked crew

lines.text: Everyone is shocked. Sanji works out that knowing this makes the crew a target for erasure.

shot.fallback: worried cook listening to a calm scientist

lines.text: Shaka calmly agrees. Sanji saw the danger first, and nobody else even asked.

shot.fallback: scientist nodding at a worried cook

lines.text: Then the Seraphim attack, and Sanji pulls Edison out of the way of a laser beam.

shot.fallback: cook pulling a scientist away from a laser

lines.text: Later he arrives just as S-Shark is about to ambush Nami, and knocks it back.

shot.fallback: cook kicking a shark boy away from a navigator

lines.text: Then he takes over that fight, and his awakened Germa enhancements mean the Seraphim can't even hurt him.

shot.fallback: cook in a black suit fighting a shark boy

lines.text: Fans will say Zoro and Luffy owned Egghead, because they had the loud fights.

shot.fallback: swordsman and captain fighting side by side

lines.text: But Sanji's job was keeping people on their feet, and I think the whole escape ran on exactly that.

shot.fallback: cook standing in front of his friends

lines.text: What he carried out of that lab was bigger than anyone he saved.

shot.fallback: blond cook carrying a scientist on his back

lines.text: Which is why nobody clapped for it, and why it was the quietest...

shot.fallback: cook standing alone on a ship deck

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim about Sanji's role in line 1
